header_fields.byte0: -> staging[+3496]? actually staging note count source; per-step count limit
header_fields.byte5: -> (>>2) [+3496] step clock period / arp rate division (1,2,3,4,6,8,16)

step_record.byte0: MIDI note (absolute, centered ~60=middle C); 0x80 = step OFF / no note
step_record.bytes1_32: 32 micro-gate cells; (cell&0x7f) nonzero = gate held that micro-tick, 0x80 terminates gate (note-off). Run-length gives gate length.
